summary: Reuse immutable installed dependency generations while keeping build snapshots inside repository-store worktrees.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only deployment tooling. A dedicated FRACTAL_DEP_CACHE is required on the snapshot filesystem; snapshots remain within store-owned worktrees and use the deployment Git wrapper.

downtime.detail: Publishing helpers does not activate or restart a service.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners explicitly configure cache and snapshot roots before adopting these helpers.

recovery.detail: Production artifact retention remains integrator-owned. Dependency generations retain selected current plus previous under snapshot-held leases; copy-mode deployment helpers remain the operational rollback.
